    • reloadTasks

      public ReloadTaskOutcome reloadTasks(Case useCase, boolean lazyCaseSave)
      Reloads all unassigned tasks of given case:
      Task is presentTask is not present
      Transition executableno actioncreate task
      Transition not executabledestroy taskno action
      Specified by:
      reloadTasks in interface ITaskService
      Parameters:
      useCase - useCase for which to reload tasks
      lazyCaseSave - if set to true, the useCase is saved only if any task is about to be executed. If set to false the useCase is saved every time this method is called.
      Returns:
      ReloadTaskOutcome, which holds the information if any task was executed and if the useCase was saved
